scenes.headline: How a fine-tune turns a model into a phone agent
scenes.sub: PhoneLLM Alpha 1: Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B, fine-tuned on agent traces.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Chive! PhoneLLM Alpha 1 is an open model tuned to handle phone calls: talk well, and actually call the tools. Here's how.

scenes.text: Take an open mixture-of-experts model and fine-tune every weight on real phone-agent traces. Same graph, same cost and speed; only the behaviour changes.
scenes.say: The idea: take an open mixture-of-experts model, and fine-tune every weight on real phone-agent traces. Same graph, same cost and speed. Only the behaviour changes.

steps.say: A token passes fifty-two layers of three kinds: Mamba2 layers, a few full-attention layers, and mixture-of-experts layers.
Each expert layer holds a hundred and twenty-eight routed experts. A token uses six, plus one shared expert that's always on.
So each token touches about three and a half billion of roughly thirty billion parameters. The card's numbers check out.

left.title: Nemotron base
left.say: Asked to book a table, the base model says it's done, and never calls the tool.

right.title: PhoneLLM Alpha 1
items: The caller gets a confirmation code
right.say: The fine-tuned model makes the reservation call, then closes the call. What it says, it does.

scenes.title: Where a voice turn's time goes

steps.say: A caller stops talking. Transcription and endpointing take about three hundred milliseconds.

steps.note: 15 stages, 1,293 ms in the card's budget
steps.say: The card's budget gives the LLM six hundred and fifty milliseconds. That's just over half of the whole loop.

steps.note: PhoneLLM's P50: 331 ms, so the loop totals 974 ms
steps.say: So the LLM is the lever. At PhoneLLM's measured three hundred and thirty-one milliseconds, the whole loop drops to nine hundred and seventy-four.

scenes.title: PhoneBench v1 score
scenes.note: the team's own benchmark; base and tuned share a cost row
scenes.say: On the team's own benchmark, the base scores twenty-eight point six. The fine-tune scores seventy-two point three, level with GPT five point six Terra.

scenes.text: Full fine-tuning bought 43.7 points of phone-agent behaviour without moving latency or cost: same graph, new weights.

recap: Fine-tuned so what it says, it does
The LLM is the voice loop's biggest lever
scenes.say: To recap: a sparse thirty B model, tuned so it does what it says, in a loop where the LLM sets the pace.
